messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — GPU pool eu-west-2/gpu-pool-7 reached 100% utilization and queue depth spiked to 18k. autoscaler attempted scaleouts but hit configured max. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west-2/d/GPUPool/gpu-pool-7

oncall-rotate: paging @sam_cooper (oncall) — can you take lead?

sam_cooper: taking it. jumping in now.

lee_wang: I see eviction rate up, tail latency climbing. queue growth started ~00:12 UTC.

maria_g: adding quick numbers: 95th latency from 220ms -> 3.1s, token throughput per GPU steady but pending_requests went from 800 -> 18k in 8m. Provider instance quota looks constant.

ashley_k: any signs of noisy tenant? which customers impacted?

maria_g: top contributors in the queue: tenant=alpha-ads (43%), tenant=finmetrics (27%), lots of small bursts from internal loadtests (12%).

devops: autoscaler logs showing repeated errors: `scale_attempt failed: quota_exceeded` + `scale_limit_reached (max_pool_size=40)`. also `scalebackoff: 30s` loop. snippet: ```[2026-03-17T00:18:02Z] scale_attempt -> error: quota_exceeded provider=aws region=eu-west-2
[2026-03-17T00:19:12Z] scale_attempt -> reached max_pool_size=40```

sre_lead: quick mitigation options: 1) shed low-priority jobs (internal/test), 2) enable fallback to smaller model variant for heavy tenants, 3) request emergency quota bump from provider, 4) temporarily increase pool max (if quota allows).

sam_cooper: doing 1 + 2 now. throttling internal loadtest tags and setting lower priority for background ingest. applying model-fallback policy for alpha-ads and finmetrics.

ashley_k: posted k8s command to drop test jobs: ```kubectl label jobs loadtest=true priority=low && ./scripts/shed-low-priority.sh --label loadtest=true```

maria_g: confirmed internal jobs dropping — queue growth slowed but still high because of tenant traffic.

devops: provider support ticket opened (CASE# RP-33219) requesting quota increase for eu-west-2. ETA unknown. attempting ephemeral scale via spare capacity in eu-west-1 as cross-region fallback.

lee_wang: enabling cross-region fallback routing for best-effort requests (non-SLA). will route alpha-ads background batches -> eu-west-1.

customer-success: flagged alpha-ads and finmetrics CSMs. CS reported degraded responses for some customers. reminding support to surface any revenue-impacting reports.

sam_cooper: update: after shedding tests + enabling fallback model, effective queue depth dropped from 18k -> 4.2k in 6m. tail latency down to ~950ms. still monitoring while devops pursues quota.

devops: autoscaler finally acquired 6 extra instances via ephemeral eu-west-1 fallback, and we bumped pool to 46 across regions. provider acknowledged ticket; they say they can increase quota but need confirmation from account team.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated — traffic rerouting + throttles in place, queue draining. Pager still active until queue < 200 and tail latency < 300ms for 15m.

sre_lead: assigning postmortem: lee_wang will own, with sam_cooper and devops as authors. ACTIONS to include: tighten per-tenant rate limits, default lower max_pool_size for noisy tenants, alert on `scale_attempt quota_exceeded`, improve cross-region fallback automation, practice runbook for emergency quota requests.

lee_wang: scheduling postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. will include CSM and account team.

sam_cooper: monitoring loop active. if anything spikes I’ll re-pager. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

customer-success: will follow up with impacted customers and collate any reported incidents for postmortem notes.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED at 00:38 UTC — queue drained to 140, 95th latency back to 210ms. Follow-up meeting scheduled.
